oracle_provenance: Independent RMS harmonic arithmetic, pressure/voltage ratios and constant-power RC worked examples; manually authored engineering dispositions, not copied from shared Skill fixtures.
scope: Nonlinear/power requirement separation and discriminating experiments under a single-node thermal model; not physical reliability or product lifetime qualification.

cases.question: Does proportional acoustic gain with low harmonics and bounded thermal rise satisfy the three stated requirements?
Are orthogonal 3% and 4% harmonic RMS components exactly at the inclusive 5% THD requirement?
Must a voltage dBV field be rejected rather than treated as RMS volts?
When acoustic gain compresses without thermal input, must amplifier/limiter behavior be discriminated before blaming the coil?

checks.expected: Record amplifier output and limiter gain at matched cold-coil conditions before attributing loss to heat

cases.question: Does equal compression with excessive predicted coil temperature require cooling and resistance-based temperature evidence?

checks.expected: Measure resistance-derived coil temperature and repeat the level sweep after cooling at identical gain

cases.question: Should excessive harmonic distortion remain a transducer-versus-amplifier investigation when the thermal and compression requirements pass?
At zero elapsed time, is initial temperature exactly ambient rather than a fictitious steady-state coil rise?
Must a missing fundamental block a THD verdict instead of yielding a finite-looking percentage?
